parts.note: the floor of the ocean is pictured as the cradle on which the deep sea rests, echoing the hymn line 'rocked in the cradle of the deep'

explanation.surface: A poetic phrase that sounds like a baby's crib rocking on the waves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cradle' suggests a baby's bed or a ship; here it is the bottom on which the ocean lies.
explanation.definitionFit: The ocean floor is where the deep sea lies, so it is fancifully its cradle.

clue.text: Expelled from university and conveyed to prison

definitions.meaning: a student thrown out of Oxford or Cambridge is said to be rusticated or dismissed for good
a convicted person is dispatched to jail by the judge

explanation.surface: A student's disgrace that ends with being taken off to jail.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is British idiom both for expulsion from a university and for being jailed after sentencing.

clue.text: I'd given stress about something unintentional

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the word for stress goes round the other piece

parts.note: stress on a syllable is an accent
I'd written without its apostrophe gives the letters ID

explanation.surface: Someone claims they put emphasis on something they didn't mean to.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stress' looks like worry but is emphasis on a syllable.
explanation.definitionFit: A mishap is by nature unplanned, an event nobody meant to happen.

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Some people have thought of England as a paradise.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical garden of Adam and Eve is the classic image of a perfect place of bliss.

clue.text: Old students better out of sight

parts.note: former pupils are old boys, abbreviated OBs
better as a verb, made well again, means healed

explanation.surface: Former pupils doing better than they did, now hidden away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'better' is a verb here: to make better is to heal.
explanation.definitionFit: Something hidden from view has been concealed, blocked from being seen.

definitions.meaning: savage means fierce and murderous
the vampire Count Dracula craves human gore to drink

explanation.surface: A description of the vampire count as a brute.
explanation.walkthrough: The second reading is literal: Dracula is thirsty for blood.
explanation.definitionFit: Murderously cruel people are described as craving gore; the vampire literally does.

definitions.meaning: a very short haircut is a ... cut, so the word names that cut
a ship's company of sailors is its complement

explanation.surface: A quick route or haircut favoured by seamen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short cut' looks like a quicker route; it is a cropped hairstyle, the crew cut.
explanation.definitionFit: The body of seamen working a ship are collectively its company.

indicators.note: in places the pronoun inside the word for street

parts.note: a street is a road
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone strolled along the street with the speaker.
explanation.definitionFit: To have rambled or roved is to have drifted about with no fixed route.

clue.text: Waits with the Spanish in enlightened times

indicators.note: in places the Spanish article inside the word for times of light

parts.note: times that are lit up by the sun are daylight periods, days
el is the Spanish for the

explanation.surface: Waiting around with Spaniards during an age of reason.
explanation.walkthrough: 'enlightened times' hints at the Enlightenment but just means daylit periods, days.
explanation.definitionFit: Waits as a plural noun are periods of hold-up or postponement.

definitions.meaning: to nick is British slang for to steal, so a thief is one who nicks
British slang for a pound sterling

explanation.surface: A thief pinching a pound coin.
explanation.walkthrough: Both senses are British slang: to nick is to steal, and a nicker is a pound.
explanation.definitionFit: A thief nicks things; separately, British slang calls a pound sterling a nicker.

clue.text: Joint vote cast in Irish parliament

indicators.note: in puts the rearranged word inside the parliament's name

parts.note: the Dáil is the lower house of the Irish parliament

indicators.note: cast suggests throwing the letters into a new shape

explanation.surface: A vote cast jointly in the Irish parliament.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cast' turns the voting word into OVET. 'Joint' is a woodworking joint, not a combined effort.
explanation.definitionFit: A woodworking joint with interlocking wedge-shaped tenons is named for a bird's tail shape.

clue.text: Perhaps even I could be afraid here

indicators.note: could be says the letters of these words might form something else

explanation.surface: Someone confessing that even they might be scared here.
explanation.walkthrough: 'could be' rearranges PERHAPS EVEN I.
explanation.definitionFit: Being anxious or fearful about what might happen is a synonym for being scared.

clue.text: The same again and again the same as one that passed long ago

indicators.note: again and again says the piece is repeated, so it appears a second time

parts.note: do, short for ditto, means the same

explanation.surface: A repetitive phrase that sounds like a barman's order.
explanation.walkthrough: DO is short for ditto, 'the same'. 'passed' means died out.
explanation.definitionFit: The flightless Mauritius bird became extinct in the 1600s, the classic example of a vanished species.

clue.text: One may turn over in bed

definitions.text: One may turn over in bed

parts.words: One may turn over in bed
parts.note: a sleeper turns over in bed, but a digging tool turns over the soil in a flower bed

explanation.surface: A restless sleeper rolling over at night.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bed' is a garden bed, not a sleeping place.
explanation.definitionFit: A gardener's digging tool turns the soil in a flower bed.

definitions.meaning: to refuse permission is to withhold it
to contradict a claim is to say it is untrue

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both refusing someone something and rejecting a statement as false.

definitions.meaning: moving means in motion, stirring
someone up and about after sleeping is risen

explanation.surface: Getting up and about in the morning.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means in motion and also up and about after waking.

clue.text: Large cat making row about midnight

indicators.note: about means the word for row goes round the single letter

parts.note: a row of seats is a tier
the middle of the word night is its letter G

explanation.surface: A big cat causing a din around the middle of the night.
explanation.walkthrough: 'row' looks like a noisy quarrel but is a line, a tier; 'midnight' is the middle letter of NIGHT.
explanation.definitionFit: The striped Asian predator is the biggest member of the feline family.

clue.text: Royal seat that offers commoners rear accommodation

definitions.text: Royal seat that offers commoners rear accommodation

parts.words: Royal seat that offers commoners rear accommodation
parts.note: Windsor is a royal residence, a seat of the monarchy, but this seat is a wooden chair anyone may sit on

explanation.surface: A royal castle that lets ordinary people stay at the back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Royal seat' suggests a castle; 'rear accommodation' is room for one's bottom. Windsor Castle is a British royal residence.
explanation.definitionFit: A wooden spindle-backed chair is named after the town of the royal castle, yet is everyday furniture.

parts.note: pro means in favour of
the pound is the unit of British sterling currency

explanation.surface: Arguing in favour of the British currency.
explanation.definitionFit: To put forward an argument or theory for consideration is to set it out.

definitions.meaning: a fine is a penalty a court imposes
a grammatical string of words

explanation.surface: An ironic remark about grand talk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fine' looks like an adjective praising the words; it is a court's penalty.
explanation.definitionFit: A court's punishment, such as a fine, is passed down; separately, a group of words forms a grammatical unit.

clue.text: What postgraduates work for, to a greater extent?

definitions.meaning: a master's or doctorate is an advanced qualification after a first degree
more so, by a larger amount

explanation.surface: Asking what postgraduate students are working towards.
explanation.definitionFit: A master's or doctorate is an advanced university qualification; the phrase also means more so.

clue.text: Commercial fee for money conversion follows slowly

parts.note: a television commercial is an advertisement, an ad
an agio is the charge for exchanging one currency for another

explanation.surface: A financial notice about exchange fees followed at a leisurely pace.
explanation.walkthrough: 'slowly' is a musical tempo marking.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian musical direction tells players to perform at a leisurely tempo.

definitions.meaning: a route or line of travel taken
a golf or racing ground is a place for sport

explanation.surface: Asking the way to a sports ground.
explanation.definitionFit: A route followed is one sense; a racecourse or golf links is the other.

clue.text: How five hundred initially must get sea transport

indicators.note: initially says the numeral comes first, before the other word

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for five hundred
taken as written

explanation.surface: A question about how a large number must find a ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' looks like a first-letter signal but just places D at the front.
explanation.definitionFit: An Arab sailing vessel with a lateen sail is a traditional boat of the Indian Ocean.

definitions.meaning: in mathematics the number one is called by this name
the goal of joining together is oneness

explanation.surface: A single aim for an alliance.
explanation.definitionFit: Mathematicians call the number one by this name, and togetherness is what an alliance aims for.

clue.text: Place where spinners will take a turn

definitions.meaning: a location or site

definitions.text: where spinners will take a turn
definitions.meaning: in cricket, spin bowlers aim at a worn patch of the pitch where the ball grips and turns

explanation.surface: A location where spinning dancers or tops take their go.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, spinners are slow bowlers who make the ball turn off the pitch; 'take a turn' looks like 'have a go'.
explanation.definitionFit: A location is a site; a worn patch on a cricket pitch helps spin bowlers.

clue.text: This woman, in truth, is at the head of a big place

indicators.note: the name stands at the front of the word, ahead of what is removed

parts.note: veracity means truthfulness
a large town is a city

explanation.surface: A woman who is truthful runs a large establishment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is at the head of' means the name is what remains when the big place is taken off the end of the word for truth.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a woman's given name, so it can stand for a particular woman.

definitions.meaning: a large furry mammal such as a grizzly
to shoulder a burden is to carry it
to stomach something is to tolerate it

explanation.surface: Asking which body part of a creature is meant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shoulder' and 'stomach' look like body parts; both are verbs meaning to carry or put up with.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names a large mammal and is a verb for carrying a load or tolerating something.

indicators.note: ground as in crushed or milled, so the letters are broken up and remade

explanation.surface: Planting something in top-quality soil.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ground' looks like soil but signals rearranging IN GRADE A.
explanation.definitionFit: A fragrant white-flowered evergreen shrub is a well-known garden and house plant.

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps
a go is a turn, as in a game

explanation.surface: Troops departing and arriving again.
explanation.walkthrough: 'go' is a noun, a turn in a game.
explanation.definitionFit: To get back to a place one left is to arrive there again.

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered widely, so the letters are strewn into a new order

explanation.surface: Poems being transmitted on the radio.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Works' looks like a noun, poems; it is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A machine or person that functions or runs something is working it.

definitions.meaning: a partnership trick-taking game played with a full deck
a pontoon is a floating structure used to cross water

explanation.surface: Naming pontoon as a card game.
explanation.walkthrough: Pontoon is itself a card game, the misdirection; here it means a floating crossing.
explanation.definitionFit: Contract whist's successor is a partnership card game, and a crossing over a river is also called this.
